definitions.explanation: Describes doing something without meaning to, due to a momentary lapse in attention. Combines つい (unintentionally) with うっかり (carelessly) to emphasize the accidental nature of the action.

examples.japanese: ついうっかり⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
ついうっかり⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally let the secret slip.

examples.japanese: ついうっかり⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{過|す}ごして→乗り過ごす：07928_norisugosu⟧、⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧しまった。
examples.english: I absentmindedly rode past my station and ended up at the last stop.

notes:
A compound adverb combining つい (unintentionally, before one realizes) and ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧ (carelessly, absentmindedly). The two words reinforce each other to describe a momentary lapse. Very natural and common in spoken Japanese.

USAGE:
Almost always followed by てしまう (or its casual form ちゃう), since the action is unintentional and often regrettable. Both つい and ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧ can be used independently with similar meanings, but the combination is more emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ついうっかり⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ — to carelessly forget
- ついうっかり⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまう — to accidentally say something
- ついうっかり⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまう — to fall asleep without meaning to
- ついうっかり⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧ — to make a careless mistake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- つい — unintentionally; milder, can also imply yielding to temptation
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧ — carelessly; focuses on inattention
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず — involuntarily; implies a reflexive or instinctive action
